defensives.name: Enraged Regeneration
defensives.usage_rule: Use it preemptively before a heavy incoming damage window, and keep casting Bloodthirst through its duration since Bloodthirst's healing is boosted while it is up.

defensives.name: Spell Reflection
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it right before a known enemy spell hits you to reflect or avoid magic damage, timed off a cast-tracking addon since it cannot be identified purely on sight.

defensives.name: Impending Victory
defensives.usage_rule: Spend it to heal yourself back up when your health dips low and you can safely spare the GCD.

defensives.name: Rallying Cry
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to help the raid survive a known damage mechanic rather than as a personal cooldown, and remember it is on the GCD so time it early.
